images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable, dominant protagonist, one decisive action: an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The disaster-film first responder is standing tall with forepaws elevated on a glass skyscraper exterior above traffic during a Desert relic signal from a Sunken ancient temple. A mirror-polished villain mask reflects an ancient map light across the facade. Every raindrop freezes except one, and the single moving drop points to the safe route. A frozen debris halo surrounds the cat. The miniature world crowns the cat as its protector with a tiny original crown raised by safe projected citizens. The offended open-mouth protest and standing tall with forepaws elevated are explicit.
